subject: general
question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at MN as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58511a055595b66442bfea640c1fd386e0acbf9a1280ad2b0aa709fe806b24a1.png]
solution:
When the mirror is placed vertically to the object, then the image formed will be laterally inverted. In other words, the Left Hand Side and Right Hand Side interchange their positions while top and bottom will remain same.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/945507fe2a4a742b0adac472a345dd97f6b0daab62f4a5963fb5553a89a9bca8.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **option (4)**
